questions.question: Class aur object kya hain?
questions.answer: Class blueprint hai; object us blueprint ka real instance. Ek class se multiple objects ban sakte hain.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: self kya hota hai?
questions.answer: Instance method me current object ka reference. self.brand jaise attributes us object ke data ko access karte hain.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Instance/class/static method difference?
questions.answer: Instance method self use karta hai, classmethod cls se class data handle karta hai, staticmethod ko self/cls ki zarurat nahi.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Inheritance aur overriding?
questions.answer: Inheritance me child parent ka code reuse karta hai. Overriding me child same method ko apne behavior se redefine karta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Polymorphism kya hai?
questions.answer: Same interface/method call ko different classes apne behavior ke saath implement karti hain.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Encapsulation/property ka use?
questions.answer: Data ko controlled access dena. @property getter ko attribute-style access deta hai; setter validation add kar sakta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. Mini speaking drill: Har answer bina PDF dekhe 2 baar bolo. Dusri baar ek real example add karo.

questions.question: Private balance + property setter validation.
questions.answer:
Private balance + property setter validation.
class Account: def __init__(self,b): self._balance=b @property def balance(self): return self._balance @balance.setter def balance(self,v): if v<0: raise ValueError("negative") self._balance=v
print(Account(100).balance) EXPECTED RESULT 100
